- **What was wrong:** run_once section 1 read `daily_bars(symbol)` alone. The daily price files deliberately exclude the session in progress, so the live RSI and holding-cap exits evaluated on closes through D-1 and could only act one session after a condition became true. `bars_held` returned k-1 on session D+k, so the 20-session cap fell on D+21 instead of D+20. The entry path already appended today's bar; the exit path did not. 459 of 698 historical exits (221 reverted + 238 time_exit) sit in the affected population.
- **Correction:** Two edits in src/event_aware_trader/autotrade.py. (1) Section 1 now fetches today's forming bar for HELD non-crypto symbols only via _todays_bars. (2) The mean-reversion exit branch applies _with_today(series, todays_for_exits.get(symbol)) before should_exit. Per C-19 no separate bars_held adjustment was made: the same expression now counts today and returns k automatically. A second adjustment would double-count.
- **Affects:** LIVE money path - decision timing only. No strategy rule, parameter, universe or limit changed.
